en.askTitle: Enter your own city, due date, pay and leave and get the same first-year baby budget
en.runTitle: Columbus, Ohio: a first-year baby budget for a couple expecting in May 2027

fields.label: Take-home pay
fields.placeholder: e.g. $6,800 a month combined after tax

fields.label: Savings and existing monthly surplus
fields.placeholder: e.g. $12,000 saved and about $600 left over each month

fields.label: Each parent’s leave benefits
fields.placeholder: e.g. 6 weeks at 60% pay for one parent, unpaid leave for the other

fields.label: Health plan and premium change
fields.value: Both employed with employer health insurance

fields.label: Feeding budget assumptions
fields.placeholder: e.g. formula only, or a mix with breastfeeding

fields.label: Childcare start date and quotes
fields.value: Childcare from month 4, comparing a centre, in-home care and a nanny share in Columbus

en.template: Plan a first-year baby budget for my family in {city}, due {due}, with {pay}, {savings}, {leave}, {health}, {feeding} and {childcare}. Separate prebirth costs, spending, lost income and confirmed benefits; show monthly cash peaks and an Ohio paid-leave verification checklist. Plan only; do not contact providers, sign up or buy anything.

phases.title: Research current prices, childcare costs, benefits and safety guidance
phases.note: Tax credits, leave rules, gear listings and Columbus childcare rates
phases.judgment: It would not guess the 2027 tax figure: the Child Tax Credit is confirmed at $2,200 for 2026 and used as a clearly labelled stand-in, and an unofficial $2,300 forecast was left out.

phases.title: Build the editable workbook and a one-page planning guide with sources
phases.note: One-off gear, monthly consumables, birth costs, childcare and a May 2027 to April 2028 cash view

phases.title: Recalculate the workbook and check the guide before handing over
phases.judgment: It kept the Ohio paid-leave answer honest: the official list showing no state programme is an older one, and whether anything has been enacted since was not fully checked, so the guide includes a checklist to verify it.

workers: Read the official sources on the 2027 Child Tax Credit, dependent-care limits, unpaid family leave, Ohio leave rules and safe secondhand gear
Collected current public prices for two tiers each of car seat, crib, mattress, stroller, high chair and carrier, plus diapers and formula
